preconditions.description: The desired length of the string and the length of the string bought by Gabi are within the range of 1 to 100000.
The difference between the desired length and the length of the string bought by Gabi is at most 2000.
The string s consists only of opening and closing round brackets.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the number of valid pairs of strings p and q that can be used to complete the string s to a valid sequence of round brackets.
